callerEvidence.evidence: Nonempty trimmed body, at least one photo, link required unless dealType1, title50 UTF16 default, max9 photo default, checkAgree before startSubmit.
Success starts submission regardless of returned Integer. Unsuccessful status-1 opens agreement; other failures keep the error.
Server checkUrl before saving link; sale0/purchase1/exchange2; personal2/merchant1; exchange forces personal2; face-price mode3 sets face_deal1 and clears price; other modes preserve price.
Preset config serializes configId, configTitle.value/other0, ram.value/other0, rom.value/other0. Ordinary model selection updates productId/category/config without creating a target association.
Product-page entry explicitly binds targetType product_phone and targetId. Other secondhand entries use an independent productId.
Serialized keys product_config_source, ershou_product_id, store_type, deal_type, exchange_price_type, is_face_deal, ershou_status, feed_id and location fields. isSelled returns status<0.
Public O constant is country; resolves the SecondHandInfo.getCountry SerializedName annotation without guessing.
Feed target helpers derive last9 digits of tid as numeric targetId; prefixes1 apk,3/5 tag,7 product_phone. Unknown nonempty targets cannot safely be cleared during edit.
Edit model reconstructs original payload. Visibility uses Feed.getPublishStatus()==1 for self-only; is_anonymous is a separate property and does not select visibility.
Only owner with SecondHandInfo, nonnegative status and not currently busy receives close action; changeStatus is fixed-1. Confirmation says closing cannot be reopened.
Category104 skips config. Checkbox1 keys are required single choices. Manual non-extra values are {value:title,other:'0'|'1'}; extra is {value:[titles...]}.
DeviceParams.option supplies actual choices. Literal Other opens text input; itemType1 marks that custom text.

Agreement HTML and explicit acceptance GET. Native CountDownTimer10500/1000 precedes acceptance. Desktop applies 10.5-second timer and an explicit read/agree checkbox; never auto-publishes after acceptance.
Sale/purchase price modes0/3, exchange modes1/2/3. Numeric decimal keyboard8194 does not establish a two-decimal-place limit.

desktopTransportBounds.meaning: Input transport limits, not claimed phone business limits

validation.config: Only server-supplied option keys and values; Other text requires that exact official Other option. Server config/preset is re-read immediately before each create/edit. Renderer cannot supply raw JSON, arbitrary form fields, headers or endpoint URLs.
validation.edit: Fresh owner, feed type, record association and enableModify permission check; restore existing common fields/config/location/target/visibility before applying the bounded patch.
validation.close: Fresh owner/status read, explicit permanent-close confirmation, fixed status-1 write, returned Feed check and independent detail readback. Already-closed state is idempotent and sends no new changeStatus write.

asyncAndRetry: Core snapshots identity object, uid, session cookie and deviceCode; before/after/error checks reject any changed owner without returning old state or continuing another write.

Renderer keys editor, agreement and close controls by account scope and id; layout cleanup and intent snapshots suppress late hydration, upload continuation, verification retry, toast and saved callbacks.
Pending publication inputs stay frozen. Closing an in-flight close confirmation is temporarily blocked within the existing bounded request timeout.

Actual challenge or explicit numerical server rejection remains actionable. Response decode/stream/structure failures, unknown exceptions, NETWORK/HTTP and missing/malformed result become WRITE_UNCONFIRMED.
Unconfirmed close/edit offers a read-only reload; no automatic replay. Unconfirmed creation requires explicit checking of the latest own feeds before manually retrying its unchanged original intent.
Protocol HTML is rendered through the existing allowed-element renderer after removing active/embedded/form/media elements; no raw executable HTML is inserted.

implementation.visualCheck: 390px dark editor checked; no horizontal overflow. Synthetic screenshots remain ignored in .local.

Secondhand body text watcher max was not recovered. Desktop 10000 UTF16 bound is explicitly a transport bound.

Native requests Android location permission and permits a failure fallback. Desktop exposes manual location, preserves existing fields and does not invent coordinates; phone collaboration is not yet wired to this editor.
Only standard text/photo edit content is confirmed here. HTML or video records stop safely.

privacy: Evidence contains only public fixed route/field/mode/limit names and synthetic verification summaries. Original APK, recovered source, derived DEX and device screenshots stay ignored; no credentials, real identities or private account contents are recorded.
